description: This source file is a Perl module ('package') defining a namespace 'Git::SVN::Migration'. It contains functions for migrating and integrating SVN repositories with Git, including various version layout migration routines and connection minimization methods.

methods.name: migrate_from_v0
methods.description: Migrates repositories from an old v0 layout to a newer format by renaming references based on branch info and URL existence.

methods.name: migrate_from_v1
methods.description: Handles migration from git-svn v1 layout by transferring data from old SVN-related directories to a new SVN directory structure.

methods.name: read_old_urls
methods.description: Recursively reads URLs from SVN info directories to build a map of references and associated URLs.

methods.name: migrate_from_v2
methods.description: Migrates repository settings based on old configuration parameters, setting up new repository remotes accordingly.

methods.name: minimize_connections
methods.description: Optimizes SVN remote URLs and fetch configurations to reduce redundant connections by consolidating fetch URLs.

methods.name: migration_check
methods.description: Performs sequential migration steps from multiple older formats and optionally minimizes the SVN connections.
